announcements.title: What is new in 0.0.1-3
announcements.body: Codex works again: it was asking for a model it no longer has, so the run failed on its first turn. It now offers the models Codex actually has today. Linux receives automatic updates for the first time. A project no longer shows the runs of the one you had open before it, the Docs list fills in as the agent writes, and a note left for the agent stops being read as the document's first line.

announcements.title: Welcome to the first public build
announcements.body: Nexus Studio now updates itself. Downloads and release notes stay on the public releases page, and nothing about your projects leaves this machine.
